caption:
A no-show doesn't have to be a lost job.

Here's an example of the recovery sequence Black Arrow builds into a client's calendar:

1. Appointment time passes, no check-in. The CRM moves the stage to No-Show on its own.

2. Ten minutes later, a warm text goes out with a one-tap reschedule link.

3. No reply after four hours? A second text offers open slots for the week.

4. Still quiet after three days? One last soft touch, then they move to your regular nurture list instead of disappearing.

Example workflow, not a client account. Shops that reach out within minutes of a no-show rebook far more of them than shops where a missed slot just sits on the schedule.
